provenance.analysis: Static ARM64 AOT disassembly with Blutter PP annotations; no network requests, application state, credentials, browser, or user data inspected
provenance.artifact_note: Artifact names identify the original private analysis notes, not files distributed with this source. The APK and disassembly are not bundled; function addresses and binary hashes preserve the technical provenance.

authorization.value: TokenStoreService.tokenModel.token, unmodified (the response token contains its Bearer prefix)

profile.path_parameter: Exactly the same phone string passed to /security/second in the successful SMS login flow
profile.response: Root Customer object, parsed at 0x5e6890; fields include id:int?, name:String?, surname:String?, cellPhone:String?, email:String?
profile.identity_warning: JWT userId and Customer.id are not the login-flow path argument. After fetching Customer by phone, AuthSmsCubit stores returned Customer.id as SharedPrefs userId.
argument_proof: AuthSmsCubit 0x8bb094 saves argument A=x2 at fp-0x88 and B=x3 at fp-0x90.
It creates VerifyCodeParams with off7=B and offb=A (0x8bb0e0, 0x8bb0e8).
VerifyCodeUseCase 0x5e6b98 calls repository 0x8bb7c4 with x2=B and x3=A.
Repository swaps x2 and x3 at 0x8bb7d8..0x8bb7e0 and calls API 0x8bb984 at 0x8bb814, therefore API receives x2=A and x3=B.
API 0x8bb984 serializes x2 under phone and x3 under smsCode, proving A is phone.
On verification success, Cubit passes original A directly to 0x8bb598 at 0x8bb16c/0x8bb170.
Function 0x8bb598 calls GetCustomerUseCase 0x5e6858 with that same x2 at 0x8bb5d4; wrapper and repository pass x2 unchanged to AuthApi 0x8bb6d8.
AuthApi passes supplied x2 to URL builder 0x5e6b3c, which concatenates customer path prefix with the argument; GET appears at 0x8bb784.
Function 0x8bb598 reads returned Customer.off7 (Customer.id) at 0x8bb5ec and stores it as SharedPrefs userId at 0x8bb604..0x8bb608.

refresh.authorization_detail: Options.extra has no accessToken key, so AuthInterceptor adds no Authorization header
refresh.source: Refresh function 0x8ba834 reads TokenStoreService.offf TokenModel; model.offb => x2 access token, model.off7 => x3 refresh token; API 0x5e4c14 maps x3 to refreshToken and x2 to token
refresh.success: HTTP200, root response parsed with TokenModel parser 0x5e50c8, then both fields saved via 0x8ba9b0
refresh.normalization_note: If the implementation strips Bearer prefixes when storing tokens, reconstruct the original raw token strings before mirroring this request. APK does not normalize either field.

last_location.response: Root CustomerAddress object; no embedded store fields in the app model

geographic_point.proof: 0x87337c reads CustomerAddress.off13 location -> Location.offb geometry -> Geometry.offb coordinates; first via 0x42f2e8 to LatLng.off7 then query latitude; last via 0x417084 to LatLng.offf then query longitude
geographic_point.note: Mirror this app's coordinate ordering; do not automatically swap to longitude/latitude based on GeoJSON conventions. For automatic selection require exactly two valid finite numbers; omit fallback when no usable saved point.

store_selection.b2b: b2bStore or corpB2bStore, depending service flag

response.selected_store_id: JSON id, object.off7; /cart/merchant merchantId and /cart/v2/bymerchant platformId both receive this same selected currentShop.id
response.platform_id_proof: 0x8a5f2c calls currentShop 0x378df8, 0x8a5f40 reads shop.off7, 0x8a5f78 calls usecase 0x595ab0, 0x595ad0 calls repository 0x8a6a24, 0x8a6a64 calls API 0x8a6aec, API serializes platformId at 0x8a6b40..0x8a6b60
response.note: Do not substitute code or typeId for the selected store id.
